home.founderHeading: Born in Yunnan. Shaped by Experiences Abroad.
home.founderAlt: Joy Liu, founder of Hidden China Travel
home.founderP1: I grew up in Yunnan and later lived in Japan and the Philippines.
home.founderP2: Living abroad meant becoming the foreign visitor myself. Everyday tasks that local people take for granted, such as making payments, using transportation or understanding unfamiliar systems, suddenly required more preparation and trusted local context.
home.founderP3: That experience changed the way I think about travel.
home.founderP4: I created Hidden China Travel to help international visitors experience Yunnan with fewer uncertainties, more personal support and enough time to appreciate the places between the famous landmarks.
home.founderP5: I am your travel consultant at Yunnan Meizhen International Travel Agency. I help shape the route, then the agency confirms the contract, receives payment and operates the journey.

faqs: How much does a private Yunnan journey cost?

Pricing depends on the route, number of travelers, travel dates and hotel standard. After learning more about your plans, we will provide a tailored quotation with the inclusions and exclusions clearly explained.

Yes. Suggested journeys are starting points rather than fixed packages. We can adjust the number of days, pace, hotels, destinations, activities and level of guiding according to your group’s interests and requirements.
Do I need to pay before receiving a proposed route?
No. You can begin by sharing your dates, approximate trip length, group size and interests. Payment is only discussed after you have reviewed the proposed arrangements and quotation.
Who operates the journey in Yunnan?

Hidden China Travel is the English-language site of {agencyEn} ({agencyZh}), a licensed travel agency in Kunming. Joy Liu is your travel consultant. You speak with Joy from the first enquiry through the journey.
How do payment and cancellation work?

After you confirm the written itinerary and travel contract, pay a 20% deposit to {agencyEn}’s corporate account by Alipay, WeChat, or bank transfer. The account name matches the company on the contract. We then book hotels, tickets and the vehicle. The remaining 80% is due after your first pickup, when the journey starts. Cancel more than 7 days before the journey starts and the deposit is refunded, minus hotel or ticket costs that have already been booked and cannot be recovered. Cancellations 7 days or fewer before departure keep the deposit.

Inclusions vary by journey but include private transport, a driver-guide throughout, accommodation and selected attraction tickets. Your proposal states what is included and what you pay for separately. The agency holds 2026 travel-agency liability insurance with China Pacific Property Insurance, policy AKUM0AC10625QAAA1R9T, up to RMB 1.8 million per person for injury it is legally responsible for. It applies to you only after your name and passport number are registered. Buy your own international medical and evacuation insurance. It is not included.
How soon will I receive a reply?
Joy normally replies within 2 hours on weekdays, 9:00–18:00 Beijing time, and within 24 hours at other times. More detailed proposals may take longer for complex routes or busy dates.

journey.yunnanNotesHeading: A few things to know about Yunnan.
journey.yunnanNotesSub: Elevation, sun, clothing, custom, and food.

yunnanNotes.title: Altitude
yunnanNotes.copy: Yunnan is a mountain plateau. Most places sit at a moderate elevation, and some are high. Lijiang is about 2,400 meters (7,900 feet), and Shangri-La about 3,400 meters (11,200 feet). If your route includes either, prepare for the altitude.

yunnanNotes.title: Sun
yunnanNotes.copy: The elevation makes the ultraviolet light strong in every season. Bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

yunnanNotes.title: Clothing
yunnanNotes.copy: The temperature can swing sharply, sometimes through several seasons in a single day. Dress in layers so you can add or remove a piece as it changes.

yunnanNotes.title: Local custom
yunnanNotes.copy: Yunnan is home to more ethnic groups than any other province in China, and customs differ from place to place. During visits, follow local practice and treat people’s homes, temples, and ceremonies with respect.

yunnanNotes.title: Food
yunnanNotes.copy: The cooking changes with the region. Dishes worth seeking out include crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, Xuanwei ham, flower cakes, Dai-style rice eaten by hand, and steam-pot chicken.
